text_en: Then the king of Egypt gathered great forces, like the sand by the seashore, and many ships; and he tried to get possession of Alexander’s kingdom by trickery and add it to his own kingdom.
text_cn: 埃及王聚集了多如海沙的大军，和许多船只，图谋用诡计夺取亚历山大的国土，归属自己的版图；

text_en: He set out for Syria with peaceable words, and the people of the towns opened their gates to him and went to meet him, for King Alexander had commanded them to meet him, since he was Alexander’s father-in-law.
text_cn: 他便一路扬言和平，往叙利亚进发，各城的居民都给他们开门，迎接他，因为亚历山大曾下令，要人欢迎他，因为他是自己的岳父。

text_en: But when Ptolemy entered the towns he stationed forces as a garrison in each town.
text_cn: 但是，每当仆托肋米进入一城，就在那城内派上自己的军队防守；

text_en: When he approached Azotus, they showed him the burnt-out temple of Dagon, and Azotus and its suburbs destroyed, and the corpses lying about, and the charred bodies of those whom Jonathan had burned in the war, for they had piled them in heaps along his route.
text_cn: 及至来近阿左托时，人便将焚毁了的达贡庙、阿左托和其周围的废墟，以及横躺竖卧的尸体，和战时被焚烧的遗骸，堆积在他要经过的路旁，指给他看；

text_en: They also told the king what Jonathan had done, to throw blame on him; but the king kept silent.
text_cn: 并将约纳堂行的事，陈述给王，意思是要王惩罚他，王却默然不语。

text_en: Jonathan met the king at Joppa with pomp, and they greeted one another and spent the night there.
text_cn: 那时，约纳堂又堂堂正正地来到了约培，与王会面；彼此请安，还一起在那里过宿。

text_en: And Jonathan went with the king as far as the river called Eleutherus; then he returned to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 约纳堂陪伴君王，来到称为厄娄特洛的河那里，才返回耶路撒冷。

text_en: So King Ptolemy gained control of the coastal cities as far as Seleucia by the sea, and he kept devising wicked designs against Alexander.
text_cn: 仆托肋米王既占领了沿海各城，直到临海的色娄基雅，就对亚历山大起了恶意，

text_en: He sent envoys to King Demetrius, saying, “Come, let us make a covenant with each other, and I will give you in marriage my daughter who was Alexander’s wife, and you shall reign over your father’s kingdom.
text_cn: 于是派遣使者见德默特琉王说：“请你来，我们彼此结为同盟，我要将嫁与亚历山大的女儿给你为妻，你在你的祖国将要为王。

text_en: I now regret that I gave him my daughter, for he has tried to kill me. ”
text_cn: 我后悔把我的女儿嫁给了他，因为他竟然谋害我。”

text_en: He threw blame on Alexander because he coveted his kingdom.
text_cn: 他诬枉亚历山大，是因为他垂涎他的国土。

text_en: So he took his daughter away from him and gave her to Demetrius. He was estranged from Alexander, and their enmity became manifest.
text_cn: 于是将自己的女儿抢去，嫁给德默特琉，而与亚历山大绝交；他们之间的仇恨就此公开了。

text_en: Then Ptolemy entered Antioch and put on the crown of Asia. Thus he put two crowns on his head, the crown of Egypt and that of Asia.
text_cn: 仆托肋米进了安提约基雅，就戴上了亚细亚的王冠：这样在他的头上戴着埃及和亚细亚的两顶王冠。

text_en: Now King Alexander was in Cilicia at that time, because the people of that region were in revolt.
text_cn: 那时，亚历山大王正在基里基雅，因为那地方的人民发生了变乱。

text_en: When Alexander heard of it, he came against him in battle. Ptolemy marched out and met him with a strong force, and put him to flight.
text_cn: 但亚历山大一听说这事，就来与他交战；仆托肋米王也率领大军来猛攻亚历山大，将他击败。

text_en: So Alexander fled into Arabia to find protection there, and King Ptolemy was triumphant.
text_cn: 亚历山大便逃到阿剌伯在那里避难，仆托肋米王于是胜利了。

text_en: Zabdiel the Arab cut off the head of Alexander and sent it to Ptolemy.
text_cn: 阿剌伯人匝贝狄耳便砍了亚历山大的头，送给了仆托肋米。

text_en: But King Ptolemy died three days later, and his troops in the strongholds were killed by the inhabitants of the strongholds.
text_cn: 三天后，仆托肋米王也死了，他留在堡垒里的埃及人，也被堡垒里的本地人杀死。

text_en: So Demetrius became king in the one hundred sixty-seventh year.
text_cn: 德默特琉遂登上王位，时在一百六十七年。

text_en: In those days Jonathan assembled the Judeans to attack the citadel in Jerusalem, and he built many engines of war to use against it.
text_cn: 那时，约纳堂召集犹太人，攻打耶路撒冷的堡垒；为攻打堡垒，制造了许多军械。

text_en: But certain renegades who hated their nation went to the king and reported to him that Jonathan was besieging the citadel.
text_cn: 有些怀恨自己百姓的歹徒，竟来到王前，将约纳堂围攻堡垒的事，向他报告了。

text_en: When he heard this he was angry, and as soon as he heard it he set out and came to Ptolemais; and he wrote Jonathan not to continue the siege, but to meet him for a conference at Ptolemais as quickly as possible.
text_cn: 王听了大怒，就立刻动身，到了仆托肋买，给约纳堂写信，要他停止围攻，且叫他赶快来仆托肋买，与他会面商谈。

text_en: When Jonathan heard this, he gave orders to continue the siege. He chose some of the elders of Israel and some of the priests, and put himself in danger,
text_cn: 约纳堂听说后，仍下令继续围攻，选了以色列中的几位长老和司祭，与他同去冒险，

text_en: for he went to the king at Ptolemais, taking silver and gold and clothing and numerous other gifts. And he won his favor.
text_cn: 且带着金银、衣服和许多别的礼品，前往仆托肋买，来会见君王，甚得君王的欢心。

text_en: Although certain renegades of his nation kept making complaints against him,
text_cn: 这时，百姓中有几个歹徒，仍来控告他；

text_en: the king treated him as his predecessors had treated him; he exalted him in the presence of all his Friends.
text_cn: 但是王对待他，仍如前王对待他一样，在自己的众位朋友前赞扬他；

text_en: He confirmed him in the high priesthood and in as many other honors as he had formerly had, and caused him to be reckoned among his chief Friends.
text_cn: 并且保证他仍作大司祭，仍享有从前所有的各种特殊荣誉，还将他列入王的一等朋友之中。

text_en: Then Jonathan asked the king to free Judea and the three districts of Samaria from tribute, and promised him three hundred talents.
text_cn: 约纳堂便要求王豁免犹太及撒玛黎雅三区的赋税，而许给王三百“塔冷通”。

text_en: The king consented, and wrote a letter to Jonathan about all these things; its contents were as follows:
text_cn: 王应允了，并且关于这一切事，还给约纳堂写了以下的信说：

text_en: “King Demetrius to his brother Jonathan and to the nation of the Jews, greetings.
text_cn: “德默特琉王祝约纳堂兄和犹太民族安好！

text_en: This copy of the letter that we wrote concerning you to our kinsman Lasthenes we have written to you also, so that you may know what it says.
text_cn: 关于你们的事，我们已给我们的亲贵拉斯特乃去了信，如今我们将原文录下，送给你们，使你们知道它的内容：

text_en: ‘King Demetrius to his father Lasthenes, greetings.
text_cn: ‘德默特琉王祝亚父拉斯特乃安好！

text_en: We have determined to do good to the nation of the Jews, who are our friends and fulfill their obligations to us, because of the goodwill they show toward us.
text_cn: 我们决意要善待犹太民族，因为他们是我们的朋友，对我们保持了正义，且怀有善意。

text_en: We have confirmed as their possession both the territory of Judea and the three districts of Aphairema and Lydda and Rathamin; the latter, with all the region bordering them, were added to Judea from Samaria. To all those who offer sacrifice in Jerusalem we have granted release from the royal taxes that the king formerly received from them each year, from the crops of the land and the fruit of the trees.
text_cn: 因此，我们也将犹太地，及由撒玛黎雅划归犹太的阿斐赖玛、里达和辣玛塔因三区， 以及一切属镇，归于他们。凡到耶路撒冷献祭的人，他们从前每年应向王缴纳地产和树上的果实等税，现在我一律豁免。

text_en: And the other payments henceforth due to us of the tithes, and the taxes due to us, and the salt pits and the crown taxes due to us—from all these we shall grant them release.
text_cn: 其他凡归于我们的什一之物、经常税、盐井税，以及应归于我们的王冠金等，从今日起，一概豁免。

text_en: And not one of these grants shall be canceled from this time on forever.
text_cn: 凡此种种，由今日起，直到无限期，一概不得废除。’

text_en: Now therefore take care to make a copy of this, and let it be given to Jonathan and put up in a conspicuous place on the holy mountain. ’”
text_cn: 所以，现在请你们费心，再将这张公文誊抄一份，送给约纳堂，叫他放在圣山的显明处。”

text_en: When King Demetrius saw that the land was quiet before him and that there was no opposition to him, he dismissed all his troops, all of them to their own homes, except the foreign troops that he had recruited from the islands of the nations. So all the troops who had served under his predecessors hated him.
text_cn: 此后，德默特琉王见自己治理的国泰民安，无人造反，便将所有的军队遣散，各回本乡，只有由异民海岛招募来的外方军队例外，因而他父亲的旧部队都恼恨他。

text_en: A certain Trypho had formerly been one of Alexander’s supporters; he saw that all the troops were grumbling against Demetrius. So he went to Imalkue the Arab, who was bringing up Antiochus, the young son of Alexander,
text_cn: 那时，原先曾作亚历山大同党的特黎丰，见众军队抱怨德默特琉，遂去见教养亚历山大幼子安提约古的阿剌伯人依玛谷。

text_en: and insistently urged him to hand Antiochus over to him, to become king in place of his father. He also reported to Imalkue what Demetrius had done and told of the hatred that the troops of Demetrius had for him; and he stayed there many days.
text_cn: 他催逼他将孩子交给自己，使他继承他父亲的王位；也将德默特琉的一切作为，以及众军队愤恨他的事，都给依玛谷述说了。以后他在那里也住了多日。

text_en: Now Jonathan sent to King Demetrius the request that he remove the troops of the citadel from Jerusalem, and the troops in the strongholds; for they kept fighting against Israel.
text_cn: 那时，约纳堂遣人到德默特琉王前，要求他将耶路撒冷堡垒里及各营寨里的人撤回，因为他们常攻击以色列人。

text_en: And Demetrius sent this message back to Jonathan: “Not only will I do these things for you and your nation, but I will confer great honor on you and your nation, if I find an opportunity.
text_cn: 德默特琉遂差遣人到约纳堂那里去说：“我不但对你和你的民族要作这些事，几时我有好机会，我还要极力光荣你和你的民族。

text_en: Now then you will do well to send me men who will help me, for all my troops have revolted. ”
text_cn: 现在更好请你派遣一些人，来帮助我出征，因为我的一切军队都已离去。”

text_en: So Jonathan sent three thousand stalwart men to him at Antioch, and when they came to the king, the king rejoiced at their arrival.
text_cn: 约纳堂便给他往安提约基雅调去三千勇兵；他们来到王前，王因他们的来临感到喜乐。

text_en: Then the people of the city assembled within the city, to the number of a hundred and twenty thousand, and they wanted to kill the king.
text_cn: 那时，约有十二万市民，在城中心集合，想要杀害国王，

text_en: But the king fled into the palace. Then the people of the city seized the main streets of the city and began to fight.
text_cn: 国王便躲到宫殿里去。市民一占据城中要道，即开始进攻。

text_en: So the king called the Jews to his aid, and they all rallied around him and then spread out through the city; and they killed on that day about one hundred thousand.
text_cn: 国王遂求犹太人帮忙，他们便一起聚集到他跟前，然后分散到城里，在那一天杀了约十万人，

text_en: They set fire to the city and seized a large amount of spoil on that day, and saved the king.
text_cn: 也把城烧了，同时获得了许多战利品，且营救了国王。

text_en: When the people of the city saw that the Jews had gained control of the city as they pleased, their courage failed and they cried out to the king with this entreaty:
text_cn: 城里的人见犹太人占据了城池，任意行事，都胆战心惊，遂呼求国王说：

text_en: “Grant us peace, and make the Jews stop fighting against us and our city. ”
text_cn: “请向我们伸出右手，叫犹太人停止攻击我们和城池！”

text_en: And they threw down their arms and made peace. So the Jews gained glory in the sight of the king and of all the people in his kingdom, and they returned to Jerusalem with a large amount of spoil.
text_cn: 他们遂放下武器讲和。这样，犹太人在国王及其国民前受到光荣，然后带着许多战利品，回了耶路撒冷。

text_en: So King Demetrius sat on the throne of his kingdom, and the land was quiet before him.
text_cn: 德默特琉王于是又坐上王位，国家在他统治下又安定了。

text_en: But he broke his word about all that he had promised; he became estranged from Jonathan and did not repay the favors that Jonathan had done him, but treated him very harshly.
text_cn: 但是他竟背弃了他所应许的一切，对约纳堂也疏远了，不但没有按照约纳堂对他所施的恩惠还报，反而处处为难。

text_en: After this Trypho returned, and with him the young boy Antiochus who began to reign and put on the crown.
text_cn: 此后，特黎丰便领着幼儿安提约古回来；安提约古于是称王， 戴上王冠。

text_en: All the troops that Demetrius had discharged gathered around him; they fought against Demetrius, and he fled and was routed.
text_cn: 此时德默特琉所遣散的军队，都聚集起来，攻击德默特琉，德默特琉只得转身逃走。

text_en: Trypho captured the elephants and gained control of Antioch.
text_cn: 特黎丰因而获得了象队，占据了安提约基雅。

text_en: Then the young Antiochus wrote to Jonathan, saying, “I confirm you in the high priesthood and set you over the four districts and make you one of the king’s Friends. ”
text_cn: 那时，小安提约古给约纳堂写信说：“我立你为大司祭，派你管辖四区，将你列入国王朋友中。”

text_en: He also sent him gold plates and a table service, and granted him the right to drink from gold cups and dress in purple and wear a gold buckle.
text_cn: 他给他送上金器和一套餐具，准他以金杯饮酒，紫袍，带金扣；

text_en: He appointed Jonathan’s brother Simon governor from the Ladder of Tyre to the borders of Egypt.
text_cn: 又任命他哥哥息孟为总督，由提洛梯山直到埃及边境，都由他管辖。

text_en: Then Jonathan set out and traveled beyond the river and among the towns, and all the army of Syria gathered to him as allies. When he came to Askalon, the people of the city met him and paid him honor.
text_cn: 那时，约纳堂出巡大河以西的各城各地， 叙利亚的军队都聚集到他跟前，助他作战；他来到阿市刻隆时，城里的居民都热烈地欢迎他。

text_en: From there he went to Gaza, but the people of Gaza shut him out. So he besieged it and burned its suburbs with fire and plundered them.
text_cn: 他又由此往迦萨去，迦萨的居民却关闭城门； 他就围攻那城，放火烧了郊区，洗劫一空。

text_en: Then the people of Gaza pleaded with Jonathan, and he made peace with them, and took the sons of their rulers as hostages and sent them to Jerusalem. And he passed through the country as far as Damascus.
text_cn: 迦萨的居民遂求约纳堂，约纳堂就同他们讲和，只是将他们首领的孩子带去，送到耶路撒冷作质。他走遍全境，直到大马士革。

text_en: Then Jonathan heard that the officers of Demetrius had come to Kadesh in Galilee with a large army, intending to remove him from office.
text_cn: 那时，约纳堂听说，德默特琉的将领们，带着大军，来到加里肋亚的卡德士，迫他放弃自己的职务；

text_en: He went to meet them, but left his brother Simon in the country.
text_cn: 他就将自己的哥哥息孟留在那里，自己迎敌去了。

text_en: Simon encamped before Beth-zur and fought against it for many days and hemmed it in.
text_cn: 息孟在贝特族尔对面扎营，攻打了多日，将那地封锁。

text_en: Then they asked him to grant them terms of peace, and he did so. He removed them from there, took possession of the town, and set a garrison over it.
text_cn: 贝特族尔人向他求和，息孟便同他们讲和，将他们从那里赶走，占据了那城，并在城里驻扎了军队。

text_en: Jonathan and his army encamped by the waters of Gennesaret. Early in the morning they marched to the plain of Hazor,
text_cn: 同时约纳堂和他的军队，在革乃撒尔湖畔扎营，第二天清早，抵达哈祚尔平原。

text_en: and there in the plain the army of the foreigners met him; they had set an ambush against him in the mountains, but they themselves met him face to face.
text_cn: 有一支外方人的军队到平原与他交战。且在山上设下埋伏。当这支军队向犹太人冲来时，

text_en: Then the men in ambush emerged from their places and joined battle.
text_cn: 埋伏的人忽然从埋伏的地方出来，与他们交战。

text_en: All the men with Jonathan fled; not one of them was left except Mattathias son of Absalom and Judas son of Chalphi, commanders of the forces of the army.
text_cn: 约纳堂的部下都逃散了，除军长阿贝沙隆的儿子玛塔提雅，和哈耳非的儿子犹大外，没有剩下一个。

text_en: Jonathan tore his clothes, put dust on his head, and prayed.
text_cn: 约纳堂便撕破衣服，头上撒土，且行祈祷。

text_en: Then he turned back to the battle against the enemy and routed them, and they fled.
text_cn: 然后转过身来，向敌人进攻，使他们溃败而逃。

text_en: When his men who were fleeing saw this, they returned to him and joined him in the pursuit as far as Kadesh, to their camp, and there they encamped.
text_cn: 他逃散的部下一见，就又回到他跟前，同他一起将敌人追赶到卡德士敌营，遂在那里安了营。

text_en: As many as three thousand of the foreigners fell that day. And Jonathan returned to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 那天外方军队死亡的，约有三千人。约纳堂以后回了耶路撒冷。
